public_notes: The verifier replays the task-specific mathematical predicate from the submitted result. The finite certificate envelope permits at most 14 coefficients in each polynomial, including trailing zero padding. The integer parameter lies in [-90,90]: any divisor constant must divide the nonzero dividend constant 90. Every coefficient has absolute value at most sum(abs(dividend))*(abs(dividend[0])+2)^(degree(dividend)+1) = 286297404070204943107692167168. This public-input bound dominates the residue recurrence and monic quadratic-division recurrence without exposing their computed coefficients. Integer fields use exact JSON-number values: 2, 2.0, and 2e0 are equivalent. Numeric tokens are limited to 4300 characters, expanded integers to 4300 digits, and decimal exponents to [-4300,4300] before conversion, in addition to the tighter magnitude bounds above. The complete UTF-8 submission file, including whitespace, is limited to 1048576 bytes. Exact-number parsing also admits at most 67108864 cumulative numeric-storage charge bytes per JSON document, charging 256 + 8*(2*token characters + absolute decimal exponent) before each numeric conversion.
